# Aura — SEO Strategy

## Keyword Strategy

### Primary Keywords
- fine dining restaurant
- modern European cuisine
- private dining NYC
- luxury restaurant
- chef's tasting menu

### Secondary Keywords
- reservation fine dining
- wine list restaurant
- private events dining
- date night restaurant
- Sunday brunch

## Metadata Plan

- **Title**: Aura — Modern European Dining | Fine Dining Restaurant
- **Description**: Experience modern European cuisine at Aura. Intimate dining, curated wine list, and private events in an elegant setting. Reserve your table today.
- **OG Tags**: Restaurant imagery, reservation link

## Local SEO Opportunities

- Google Business Profile with menu, photos, reservations
- Location-specific keywords
- Review management (Google, Yelp, OpenTable)

## Semantic Structure

- Schema.org Restaurant markup
- Menu schema for dishes
- Event schema for private dining
- Proper heading hierarchy
